blogs.title: Small Models, Big Brains: How 120 Billion Web Pages Beat Giant AI
blogs.description: Discover how DeepSeekMath proves you don't need a massive model to solve hard math problems. This post breaks down the team's innovative strategy of mining high-quality math data from the public web (Common Crawl) to train a compact 7-billion parameter model that rivals giants like GPT-4.

blogs.title: The Secret Ingredient: Why Coding Skills Make Better Mathematicians
blogs.description: Is there a hidden link between programming and algebra? We explore DeepSeekMath's surprising finding that pre-training on code significantly boosts a model's mathematical reasoning abilities, offering clues on why 'code-first' models might be the future of logical AI.

blogs.title: Meet GRPO: The New Way to Train AI Without Breaking Your GPU Budget
blogs.description: Reinforcement learning is powerful but expensive. Learn about Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a breakthrough algorithm introduced in the DeepSeekMath paper that eliminates the need for heavy 'critic' models, making it easier and cheaper to teach AI complex reasoning tasks.

blogs.title: Stop Reading ArXiv Papers? What Data Actually Makes an AI Smarter at Math
blogs.description: Everyone assumes reading academic papers makes an AI smarter at science. But new research suggests otherwise! Dive into the counter-intuitive results showing that curated web data outperforms traditional academic corpora for teaching math, and learn what this means for future AI training.
